blocks.text: Birlik va ko'plik: a train — two trains

O'zbekchada ko'plik `-lar` qo'shimchasi bilan yasaladi: kitob — kitoblar. Inglizchada ham ko'plik qo'shimchasi bor — `-s`: book — books. Lekin ikki til ko'plikni turlicha ishlatadi. O'zbekchada son va «ko'p», «bir necha» so'zlaridan keyin ot **birlikda** qoladi: uchta kitob, ko'p odam. Inglizchada esa birdan ortiq bo'lsa — doim **ko'plik**: three **books**, a lot of **people**. Bundan tashqari, o'zbekcha `-lar` ko'pincha tushib qoladi («Bozorda olma ko'p»), inglizchada esa sanaladigan otning ko'pligi tushib qolmaydi.

rows: There are a lot of **apples** at the market.

blocks.text: Ko'plik fe'lga ham ta'sir qiladi: birlik bilan — **is**, **was**, **has**, works; ko'plik bilan — **are**, **were**, **have**, work. The bus **is** late — The buses **are** late. **a / an** esa faqat birlikda keladi: **a car**, lekin cars («a cars» emas) — 65-dars.

Ko'pchilik otlar shunchaki `-s` oladi: car → cars, day → days. So'z `s`, `ss`, `sh`, `ch`, `x` bilan tugasa — `-es`: bus → buses, class → classes, dish → dishes, watch → watches, box → boxes. Sababi — talaffuz: bunday so'z oxiriga yana bitta shivirlovchi tovushni qo'shib bo'lmaydi, shuning uchun qo'shimcha alohida bo'g'in bo'ladi va `e` bilan yoziladi. potato, tomato ham `-es` oladi, lekin photo → photos, piano → pianos.

`-y` bilan tugagan so'zda oldingi harfga qarang. Undosh + `y` → `-ies`: city → cities, baby → babies, country → countries. Unli + `y` → oddiy `-s`: day → days, key → keys, boy → boys, holiday → holidays. Ba'zi `-f` / `-fe` bilan tugagan so'zlar `-ves` ga aylanadi: leaf → leaves, knife → knives, shelf → shelves, wife → wives, life → lives, half → halves. Lekin hammasi emas: roof → roofs, chef → chefs.

items.text: There are two **libraries** in our town.

blocks.text: Ba'zi juda qadimiy va ko'p ishlatiladigan so'zlar `-s` olmaydi — ularning ko'pligi butunlay boshqa shaklda. Ularni yodlash kerak, lekin ro'yxat qisqa. **sheep**, **fish** kabi so'zlarda birlik va ko'plik bir xil: one sheep — ten sheep. Bu shakllar allaqachon ko'plik, ularga yana `-s` qo'shilmaydi: children («childrens» emas), men («mens» emas).

items.text: Three **women** are working in the garden.
I've got a problem with my **teeth**.

blocks.text: **people** — «odamlar», «kishilar», ya'ni **person** so'zining ko'pligi. Shuning uchun u bilan doim ko'plik fe'li: People **are** ..., The people **were** ... Bitta odam — **a person** («a people» emas). «peoples» shakli juda kam uchraydi — «xalqlar» ma'nosida. **the police** («politsiya») ham ko'plik fe'li bilan ishlatiladi: The police **are** here. O'zbekchada esa «odam», «politsiya» birlikda turadi — shuning uchun bu yerda xato ko'p.
Doim ko'plikda: jeans, trousers, glasses, scissors

Ikki qismdan (ikki pocha, ikki oyna, ikki tig') iborat narsalar inglizchada **doim ko'plikda**: jeans, trousers, shorts, pyjamas, tights, glasses, sunglasses, scissors, headphones. O'zbekchada esa ular birlikda: shim, ko'zoynak, qaychi. Shuning uchun: My jeans **are** new («is» emas); these trousers («this trousers» emas). **a / an** bilan ishlatilmaydi — bitta narsa haqida gapirganda **a pair of** deyiladi: **a pair of** jeans, two **pairs of** scissors.

items.text: I want to buy **a pair of shorts** for the beach.

blocks.text: O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «three book» → **three books** (sondan keyin doim ko'plik); «many child» → **many children**; «childrens», «mens» → **children**, **men** (ular allaqachon ko'plik); «a people» → **a person**; «People is friendly» → **People are** friendly; «My jeans is new» → **My jeans are** new; «a scissors» → **a pair of scissors**.

Eslab qolish: birdan ortiq bo'lsa — inglizchada doim ko'plik, sondan keyin ham (two, ten, a hundred). O'zbekcha «uchta», «ko'p» dan keyin ot birlikda qolsa ham, inglizchada `-s` ni qo'shishni unutmang: uchta **kitob** — three **books**.

Hamma otlarning ham ko'pligi bo'lavermaydi: water, money, bread, advice — **sanalmaydigan** otlar, ular `-s` olmaydi (67–68-darslar). Ko'plikdagi ot bilan **a / an** ishlatilmaydi, lekin **some** («bir nechta») bo'lishi mumkin: some apples (76-dars).

rows: men, women, children, people, feet, teeth, mice

examples.title: One car, two **cars**: plural with **-s**
examples.description: Ko'pchilik otlar ko'plikda `-s` oladi. O'zbekchada sondan keyin ot birlikda qoladi («ikkita mushuk»), inglizchada esa ko'plik shart: two **cats**.

sentences.text: We've got two **cats** and a dog.
sentences.translation: Bizda ikkita **mushuk** va bitta it bor.

sentences.text: There are twenty-five **pupils** in my son's class.
sentences.translation: O'g'limning sinfida yigirma besh **o'quvchi** bor.

sentences.text: How many **brothers** and **sisters** have you got?
sentences.translation: Nechta **aka-ukangiz** va **opa-singlingiz** bor?

sentences.text: Dilnoza bought three **books** and two **pens** yesterday.
sentences.translation: Dilnoza kecha uchta **kitob** va ikkita **ruchka** sotib oldi.

sentences.text: The **shops** in our street close at nine.
sentences.translation: Ko'chamizdagi **do'konlar** soat to'qqizda yopiladi.

sentences.text: Bekzod works six **days** a week, from Monday to Saturday.
sentences.translation: Bekzod haftasiga olti **kun** — dushanbadan shanbagacha ishlaydi.

sentences.text: Are these **seats** free? — Yes, sit down, please.
sentences.translation: Bu **o'rindiqlar** bo'shmi? — Ha, marhamat, o'tiring.

sentences.text: I've got two **tickets** for the football match on Saturday.
sentences.translation: Shanba kungi futbol o'yiniga ikkita **chiptam** bor.

sentences.text: In autumn the **trees** in the park are yellow and red.
sentences.translation: Kuzda parkdagi **daraxtlar** sariq va qizil bo'ladi.

sentences.text: The **trains** to Samarkand are fast, but the **tickets** aren't cheap.
sentences.translation: Samarqandga boradigan **poyezdlar** tez, lekin **chiptalar** arzon emas.

examples.title: **-es**: buses, boxes, watches, potatoes
examples.description: `s`, `ss`, `sh`, `ch`, `x` bilan tugagan so'zlar `-es` oladi: bus → **buses**, dish → **dishes**, box → **boxes**. potato, tomato ham — **potatoes**, lekin photo → **photos**.

sentences.text: I usually take two **buses** to get to work.
sentences.translation: Ishga borish uchun odatda ikkita **avtobusga** chiqaman.

sentences.text: Can you help me with these **boxes**?
sentences.translation: Bu **qutilarni** ko'tarishga yordamlashib yuborasizmi?

sentences.text: Madina washes the **dishes** after dinner.
sentences.translation: Madina kechki ovqatdan keyin **idishlarni** yuvadi.

sentences.text: My English **classes** start at eight o'clock.
sentences.translation: Ingliz tili **darslarim** soat sakkizda boshlanadi.

sentences.text: Tom has got three **watches**, but he never wears them.
sentences.translation: Tomning uchta **soati** bor, lekin u ularni hech qachon taqmaydi.

sentences.text: We need some **potatoes** and **tomatoes** for the salad.
sentences.translation: Salat uchun bizga **kartoshka** va **pomidor** kerak.

sentences.text: There are a lot of old **churches** in Oxford.
sentences.translation: Oksfordda qadimiy **cherkovlar** ko'p.

sentences.text: How many **sandwiches** do you want for the trip?
sentences.translation: Safarga nechta **buterbrod** olasiz?

sentences.text: James sent me twenty **photos** from Bukhara, and they're beautiful.
sentences.translation: Jeyms menga Buxorodan yigirmata **surat** yubordi, ular juda chiroyli.

sentences.text: In August the **beaches** near Antalya are full of tourists, and all the hotels are busy.
sentences.translation: Avgustda Antaliya yaqinidagi **plyajlar** sayyohlarga to'la, barcha mehmonxonalar band bo'ladi.

examples.title: **-ies**: cities, babies — but days, keys
examples.description: Undosh + `y` → `-ies`: city → **cities**, country → **countries**. Unli + `y` → oddiy `-s`: day → **days**, key → **keys**, toy → **toys**.

sentences.text: Tashkent and Samarkand are big **cities**.
sentences.translation: Toshkent va Samarqand — katta **shaharlar**.

sentences.text: Our neighbours have got two **babies** — they're twins!
sentences.translation: Qo'shnilarimizning ikkita **chaqalog'i** bor — ular egizak!

sentences.text: How many **countries** have you visited?
sentences.translation: Nechta **davlatda** bo'lgansiz?

sentences.text: Oh no, I've lost my **keys** again!
sentences.translation: Voy, yana **kalitlarimni** yo'qotib qo'ydim!

sentences.text: There are a lot of **parties** at the end of the year.
sentences.translation: Yil oxirida **bayram kechalari** ko'p bo'ladi.

sentences.text: The **boys** are playing football, and the **ladies** are drinking tea.
sentences.translation: **O'g'il bolalar** futbol o'ynayapti, **ayollar** esa choy ichyapti.

sentences.text: Sarah reads two or three **stories** to her son every night.
sentences.translation: Sara har kecha o'g'liga ikki-uchta **ertak** o'qib beradi.

sentences.text: We spent our summer **holidays** in the mountains near Chimgan.
sentences.translation: Yozgi **ta'tilimizni** Chimyon yaqinidagi tog'larda o'tkazdik.

sentences.text: In June the **strawberries** and **cherries** at Chorsu Bazaar are very sweet.
sentences.translation: Iyunda Chorsu bozoridagi **qulupnay** va **gilos** juda shirin bo'ladi.

sentences.text: Two **companies** in our city make **toys**, and they sell them all over the world.
sentences.translation: Shahrimizdagi ikkita **kompaniya** **o'yinchoqlar** ishlab chiqaradi va ularni butun dunyoga sotadi.

examples.title: **-ves**: knives, shelves, leaves
examples.description: Ko'p `-f` / `-fe` bilan tugagan otlar ko'plikda `-ves` ga aylanadi: knife → **knives**, leaf → **leaves**, wife → **wives**. Istisno: roof → **roofs**, chef → **chefs**.

sentences.text: In autumn the **leaves** fall from the trees.
sentences.translation: Kuzda daraxtlardan **barglar** to'kiladi.

sentences.text: Put the **knives** and forks on the table, please.
sentences.translation: **Pichoq** va vilkalarni stolga qo'yib qo'y, iltimos.

sentences.text: The **shelves** in my room are full of books.
sentences.translation: Xonamdagi **javonlar** kitoblarga to'la.

sentences.text: Cut the melon into two **halves**.
sentences.translation: Qovunni ikki **teng bo'lakka** bo'ling.

sentences.text: Doctors and nurses save people's **lives** every day.
sentences.translation: Shifokor va hamshiralar har kuni odamlarning **hayotini** saqlab qoladi.

sentences.text: At the party all the men came with their **wives**.
sentences.translation: Ziyofatga hamma erkaklar **xotinlari** bilan keldi.

sentences.text: Yesterday the police caught two **thieves** near the market.
sentences.translation: Kecha politsiya bozor yaqinida ikki **o'g'rini** ushladi.

sentences.text: My grandmother knits warm **scarves** for all her grandchildren.
sentences.translation: Buvim barcha nevaralariga issiq **sharflar** to'qiydi.

sentences.text: Are there **wolves** in the mountains of Uzbekistan? — Yes, there are.
sentences.translation: O'zbekiston tog'larida **bo'rilar** bormi? — Ha, bor.

sentences.text: Not every word changes: the **roofs** of the old houses in Khiva are flat.
sentences.translation: Hamma so'z ham o'zgarmaydi: Xivadagi eski uylarning **tomlari** tekis.

examples.title: Irregular: **children**, **men**, **teeth**, **sheep**
examples.description: Noto'g'ri ko'plik — yodlanadi: man → **men**, woman → **women**, child → **children**, foot → **feet**, tooth → **teeth**, mouse → **mice**. sheep, fish o'zgarmaydi.

sentences.text: Madina has got three **children** — two sons and a daughter.
sentences.translation: Madinaning uchta **farzandi** bor — ikki o'g'il va bir qiz.

sentences.text: Two **men** and a **woman** are waiting outside.
sentences.translation: Tashqarida ikki **erkak** va bir **ayol** kutib turibdi.

sentences.text: Brush your **teeth** before you go to bed!
sentences.translation: Yotishdan oldin **tishingni** yuv!

sentences.text: My **feet** hurt after a long day at work.
sentences.translation: Ishdagi uzun kundan keyin **oyoqlarim** og'riyapti.

sentences.text: There are a lot of **sheep** in the fields near the village.
sentences.translation: Qishloq yaqinidagi dalalarda **qo'ylar** ko'p.

sentences.text: Did you catch anything yesterday? — Yes, five **fish**!
sentences.translation: Kecha biror narsa tutdingmi? — Ha, beshta **baliq**!

sentences.text: In my family the **women** make the best plov in Fergana.
sentences.translation: Oilamizda **ayollar** Farg'onadagi eng mazali oshni pishirishadi.

sentences.text: We've got **mice** in the kitchen, so we need a cat!
sentences.translation: Oshxonamizda **sichqonlar** bor, demak, bizga mushuk kerak!

sentences.text: The **children** are playing in the yard, and the **men** are cooking shashlik.
sentences.translation: **Bolalar** hovlida o'ynayapti, **erkaklar** esa kabob pishiryapti.

sentences.text: A small child has twenty milk **teeth**, but an adult has thirty-two.
sentences.translation: Kichkina bolaning yigirmata sut **tishi** bo'ladi, kattalarniki esa o'ttiz ikkita.

examples.title: **people**, **a person**, **the police**
examples.description: **people** — **person** ning ko'pligi, u bilan doim ko'plik fe'li: people **are**. Bitta odam — **a person**. **the police** ham ko'plik fe'li bilan: the police **are**.

sentences.text: There were five hundred **people** at my cousin's wedding.
sentences.translation: Amakivachchamning to'yida besh yuz **kishi** bor edi.

sentences.text: **People** in Bukhara are very friendly.
sentences.translation: Buxoroda **odamlar** juda samimiy.

sentences.text: Only one **person** in our office speaks Chinese.
sentences.translation: Ofisimizda faqat bir **kishi** xitoy tilida gapiradi.

sentences.text: How many **people** live in Tashkent? — About three million.
sentences.translation: Toshkentda qancha **odam** yashaydi? — Taxminan uch million.

sentences.text: The **police** are looking for the driver of the blue car.
sentences.translation: **Politsiya** ko'k mashinaning haydovchisini qidiryapti.

sentences.text: My grandfather is a very kind and wise **person**.
sentences.translation: Bobom juda mehribon va dono **inson**.

sentences.text: Why are all these **people** standing outside the bank?
sentences.translation: Nega bu **odamlarning** hammasi bank oldida turibdi?

sentences.text: The **people** next door aren't at home this week.
sentences.translation: **Qo'shnilar** bu hafta uyda emas.

sentences.text: Most **people** don't like Mondays, but I do!
sentences.translation: Ko'pchilik **odamlar** dushanbani yoqtirmaydi, men esa yoqtiraman!

sentences.text: This lift can carry eight **people**, so please wait for the next one.
sentences.translation: Bu lift sakkiz **kishini** ko'taradi, iltimos, keyingisini kuting.

examples.title: Always plural: **jeans**, **glasses**, **scissors**
examples.description: Ikki qismli narsalar inglizchada doim ko'plikda va **are** bilan: jeans, trousers, shorts, pyjamas, glasses, scissors, headphones. Bittasi — **a pair of** ...

sentences.text: My new **jeans** are too long.
sentences.translation: Yangi **jinsi shimim** juda uzun.

sentences.text: Where are my **glasses**? I can't read without them.
sentences.translation: **Ko'zoynagim** qayerda? Usiz o'qiy olmayman.

sentences.text: These **trousers** don't fit me any more.
sentences.translation: Bu **shim** endi menga to'g'ri kelmaydi.

sentences.text: I need **a pair of scissors** to open this parcel.
sentences.translation: Bu posilkani ochish uchun menga **qaychi** kerak.

sentences.text: Tom is wearing **shorts** because it's thirty degrees outside.
sentences.translation: Tashqarida o'ttiz daraja issiq, shuning uchun Tom **shorti** kiyib olgan.

sentences.text: Are these your **sunglasses**? — No, mine are black.
sentences.translation: Bu sizning **quyosh ko'zoynagingiz**mi? — Yo'q, meniki qora.

sentences.text: Aziz bought **two pairs of jeans** at the market.
sentences.translation: Aziz bozordan **ikkita jinsi shim** sotib oldi.

sentences.text: At nine o'clock the children are already in their **pyjamas**.
sentences.translation: Soat to'qqizda bolalar allaqachon **pijamalarini** kiyib olishgan bo'ladi.

sentences.text: Your **headphones** are on the sofa, next to my bag.
sentences.translation: **Quloqchinlaring** divanda, sumkamning yonida.

sentences.text: Dilnoza's **trousers** were dirty, so she wore a dress to the party.
sentences.translation: Dilnozaning **shimi** kir edi, shuning uchun u ziyofatga ko'ylak kiyib bordi.

examples.title: Singular or plural? Mixed practice
examples.description: Aralash mustahkamlash: `-s`, `-es`, `-ies`, noto'g'ri ko'plik va doim ko'plikdagi otlar; birlik — **is**, ko'plik — **are**.

sentences.text: How many **children** have you got? — Two **boys** and a **girl**.
sentences.translation: Nechta **farzandingiz** bor? — Ikkita **o'g'il** va bitta **qiz**.

sentences.text: Is this **bus** going to the centre? — No, take one of those **buses**.
sentences.translation: Bu **avtobus** markazga boradimi? — Yo'q, anavi **avtobuslarning** biriga chiqing.

sentences.text: My **glasses** are on the table, but my **phone** is in the car.
sentences.translation: **Ko'zoynagim** stol ustida, **telefonim** esa mashinada.

sentences.text: Every **child** in the class has got two **books** and a dictionary.
sentences.translation: Sinfdagi har bir **bolada** ikkita **kitob** va bitta lug'at bor.

sentences.text: There's a **mouse** in the garage! — Just one? I think there are three **mice**!
sentences.translation: Garajda **sichqon** bor! — Bittami? Menimcha, u yerda uchta **sichqon** bor!

sentences.text: One **person** is waiting outside, and two more **people** are on the phone.
sentences.translation: Tashqarida bir **kishi** kutib turibdi, yana ikki **kishi** telefonda.

sentences.text: Our flat has got three **bedrooms**, two **balconies** and a small kitchen.
sentences.translation: Kvartiramizda uchta **yotoqxona**, ikkita **balkon** va kichkina oshxona bor.

sentences.text: Do you prefer **cats** or **dogs**? — **Dogs**, definitely.
sentences.translation: Sizga **mushuklar** yoqadimi yoki **itlar**? — Albatta, **itlar**.

sentences.text: Last year James lost two **wallets**, three **umbrellas** and a lot of **keys**.
sentences.translation: O'tgan yili Jeyms ikkita **hamyon**, uchta **soyabon** va juda ko'p **kalit** yo'qotdi.

sentences.text: In the photo two **women**, a **man** and four **children** are standing in front of a church.
sentences.translation: Suratda ikki **ayol**, bir **erkak** va to'rtta **bola** cherkov oldida turibdi.
